comments.author: @Chris_at_Home
comments.text: In the early 2000s a friend and I measured-67F with a mercury thermometer at Prospect Creek. We drove to there from Pump Station 5 a few miles away. The shocks on the truck were frozen and we felt every bump. I had a couple telecom jobs where I traveled around the state. I also worked along the pipeline and in the oilfield for many years.

replies.author: @LifewaysTravel
replies.text: That's an incredible firsthand story! -67F is hard to even imagine, especially with the truck shocks freezing like that. Thanks for sharing a real glimpse of what working along the pipeline and in the oilfields was actually like back then. Experiences like yours add so much to the story. 🙌
